title: cli nightly e2e: `generate-agent-retired.e2e.test.ts` expects the pre-#20195 object template import (`import * as Data`) and fails on main
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**: `packages/cli/test/generate-agent-retired.e2e.test.ts` (the `os g object … --dry-run` case, about :150). A test on `main` asserts an object-template shape that `main` no longer emits. Finding class **(a)**, test-versus-template drift. No product behaviour is wrong.

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 2 (`session_01QcAS3qiYYZNezaxZxaUdMV`, seat post #18549), from the #20216 dev's CI-fix round (PR #20253, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens (measured by the dev, relayed)

- `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/generate-agent-retired.e2e.test.ts` fails `[#10359] … os g object … --dry-run still previews a typed object file`.
- It expects `import * as Data from '@objectstack/spec/data'`.
- Since #20195 (`0bd11261ef`), the object template writes `import { ObjectSchema } from '@objectstack/spec/data'`, declaring the object with `ObjectSchema.create`.
- The test file and the template are both identical to the merge base `c02fa1276`, so no open PR causes it.
- The case runs only in the nightly e2e tier, so per-PR CI never shows it.

## Why it matters

A nightly red that nobody owns hides the next real nightly failure behind a known one. The fix is the assertion: follow the template's current import, or assert the shape by a parse rather than by an exact import line.

## Suggested shape (⛔ not a ruling)

Update the one assertion to the template `main` emits since #20195, and run the file under `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly` green. Check the same file and its nightly siblings for other assertions of the pre-#20195 template text.

Dedupe: open and recent issues filtered locally for `generate-agent-retired` and for `import * as Data` + template → only #20195 (closed, the template change itself).
